next_step: Run 2-week cost/latency POC on Dedicated; deliver quantization+batching plan; finalize security questionnaire
notes:
Top-line: EchoQuell is a CX automation vendor serving 2k+ enterprise seats; they want to cut live agent volume by 35-50% using automated chat deflection and agent assist. Cost is a primary constraint — unit economics must show < $0.004/token equivalent for high-volume deflection. 
- Recently ran a pilot with a finetuned LLM on GCP (inference on T4s); ran into spikes (holiday sales) where latency crossed 1.2s p50 -> looking for autoscaling/overflow. 
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable unit cost when traffic spikes — can't have bills jump 3-4x." 
- Use-case specifics: 70% short chat deflection (8-40 tokens), 20% mid-form answers (40-200 tokens), 10% long summary/triage (200-800 tokens). Expect peak throughput 12k rps during campaigns. 
- Interested in batching and KV prefix caching to reduce repeated context costs; willing to trial int8 or q4 quantization if quality stays within 2% NPS delta. 
- Security: must pass SSO/SAML SSO + SOC2 audit + data residency in US for PII; KMS integration required. 
- Legal: standard SLAs + incident playbook requested. 
- Current architecture: microservices front end, Kafka for eventing, Redis cache, Postgres for ticket store. 
- Internal champions: Product VP (Avery Morales) and Head of Engineering (Samir Khan). AE Jordan introduced Redwood to CTO on 2025-01-20.
- AE notes: strong PLG motion internally; they want minimal integration effort and clear cost/latency playbooks. 
- Quote from Product VP: "If you can guarantee sub-100ms p50 on common paths and a clear cost model, we'll move to Dedicated."
technical_requirements: Latency targets: p50 <100ms for deflection short paths, p95 <500ms; throughput peak 12k rps; availability 99.95%; batching acceptable if tail latency preserved; wants configurable routing fallback to smaller model when Dedicated capacity saturated; support for streaming and tool-calling (ticket_create, triage_tag). Cost goal: <$0.004/token-equivalent for high-volume deflection using batching+caching+quantization.
